ambiguities_declared: Several population-tier rows in the monitoring table (e.g., Subpart H 50,000-249,999; Ground Water ≥00,000) leave the 'Monitoring periods and frequency of sampling' cell blank, apparently inheriting the frequency stated in the first row of that source-water-type block, but no verbatim text in those specific cells states the frequency, so it cannot be quoted as their own value without assuming inheritance.

No relation in the controlled vocabulary (has-mcl, has-mclg, has-mrdl, has-mrdlg, requires-monitoring, compliance-basis, applies-to, defined-as, requires-treatment-technique) precisely covers recordkeeping/retention duration duties (e.g., 10-year IDSE report retention in (c)(4), plan retention tied to (c)(4) in (a)(4)); these were not forced into an ill-fitting relation and are omitted from claims.

The cell text 'one (during peak historical month) 2' embeds a superscript footnote marker '2' adjacent to the frequency description without a delimiter, making it ambiguous whether '2' is part of the described count or purely a footnote reference; quoted verbatim as it appears in the source.

verified_quotes.exact_text: You must collect dual sample sets at each monitoring location. One sample in the dual sample set must be analyzed for TTHM. The other sample in the dual sample set must be analyzed for HAA5.
(2) You must take samples at locations other than the existing subpart L monitoring locations. Monitoring locations must be distributed throughout the distribution system.
(4) Your monitoring under this paragraph (b) may not be reduced under the provisions of § 141.29 and the State may not reduce your monitoring using the provisions of § 142.16(m).
(3) You must recommend and justify subpart V compliance monitoring locations and timing based on the protocol in § 141.605.
1 A dual sample set (i.e., a TTHM and an HAA5 sample) must be taken at each monitoring location during each monitoring period.
(4) You must retain a complete copy of your IDSE report submitted under this section for 10 years after the date that you submitted your report.
